notes.subject: מפלט
notes.rationale: JPS/ASV 'haste me to a shelter' (noun as place) vs KJV 'hasten my escape' (escape as act); mi holim pas bilong 'ranawe'.

notes.subject: רוח
notes.rationale: ruak — wanpela tok bilong ruak/win/Spirit, olsem D2 i lainim.

translation: Mi laik bilong spidim ⟨em⟩ — olsem wanpela bilong ol man i ranawe i salim ol yet — long pinis long ruak i strong tumas, long bikpela win sera.
